entries.what: The Bing Search APIs are retired and existing instances decommissioned.

source.quote: Bing Search APIs will be retired on August 11, 2025. Any existing instances of Bing Search APIs will be decommissioned completely

lookFor: A request to api.bing.microsoft.com, or to the older api.cognitive.microsoft.com/bing
entries.replacement: The page encourages migrating to Grounding with Bing Search as part of Azure AI Agents.
requires: Grounding with Bing Search works through an Azure AI agent, not a plain search request, so the result shape and the setup both change.

entries.what: Bing removed anonymous sitemap submission, the unauthenticated bing.com/ping request. The post is headed as removed and says it stops from its publication date. It doesn't say what a ping gets now, and that was not tested.

source.quote: we will be deprecating the ability for anonymous sitemap submissions starting today

entries.replacement: List the sitemap in robots.txt or submit it in Bing Webmaster Tools. The post also encourages IndexNow for real-time changes.
requires: There is no request to swap in for the ping itself. IndexNow is a different request with its own key, and Webmaster Tools needs an account.
